ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are three intersecting circles, with centers labeled A, B, C respectively. A slanted straight line passes through these points; along the line from left to right the order is A, F, B, G, C; point F is between A and B. In the figure, point A is on the circumference of circle B, and point F is the intersection of line AB and the right-side circumference of circle A. Then reason: The diameter of circle A is 8 inches, so the radius AF=4 inches. The diameter of circle B is 18 inches, so the radius AB=9 inches, because A is on the circumference of circle B. Since A, F, B are collinear and F is between A and B, FB=AB-AF=9-4=5.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A, F, and B lie on the same straight line, with F between A and B. Point A is on the circumference of circle B, and point F is the point where the line from A to B meets circle A on its right side. From the text, the diameters of circles A and B are 8 and 18, so their radii are 4 and 9. Since A lies on circle B, AB = the radius of circle B, 9. Since F lies on circle A, AF = the radius of circle A, 4. Therefore FB = AB - AF = 9 - 4 = 5.
